تبحبحتن (form IIq)
# تَبَحْبَحْتُنَّ (tabaḥbaḥtunna) /ta.baħ.baħ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تُبُحْبِحْتُنَّ (tubuḥbiḥtunna) /tu.buħ.biħ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
